name: Security Audit Chain
intent: Run a coordinated security audit across multiple Null AI security tools, chaining results from one tool to the next.
scope: Work only inside local_null_ai_* security tool folders.
Do not run active exploitation without explicit authorization.
All output goes to the Runs directory for the chain.

steps.title: Reconnaissance
steps.prompt: Run local_null_ai_PHISH_HUNTER_PRO or local_null_ai_backdoor_detector to identify initial targets or indicators.

steps.title: Vulnerability scan
steps.prompt: Use local_null_ai_cloudTOWN_cloudEXPLOITS or local_null_ai_Cerberus_pentest_exploit for targeted scanning.

steps.title: Evidence extraction
steps.prompt: Use local_null_ai_crypt0-extract or local_null_ai_REAPER-github secrets scanner_exploiter to extract findings.

steps.title: Report generation
steps.prompt: Consolidate all findings into a structured report. Write to the chain's runs folder.
